referenceOutput:
name: model-eval
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
    - cron: '0 14 * * *'
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: model-eval
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  evaluate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm run eval:checks
